summary.shortDescription: A single-cell regulated squonk mod rated at 95W, 6V, and a conservative 34A.
summary.description: The Pulse V2 supports one 21700 or 20700 cell, or an 18650 with adapter, and has a 5–95W, 0.5–6V, 0.05–3Ω profile. The review lists under-34A current protection while independent testing reached 35A and 111W; the runtime deliberately retains 34A as the conservative ceiling.
